title: Amelia | Effortless everyday dress with pockets
bodyHtml:
This is the dress you'll reach for on repeat—soft, breathable, and designed to move with you all day without clinging. The relaxed silhouette skims your frame beautifully, whilst practical pockets mean you're never without them. Whether you're popping out for errands or staying put, it looks naturally put-together without any fuss. It's the kind of piece that works whether you're heading to the shops or meeting friends for coffee.

Why you'll love it

  • All-day comfort that doesn't require thinking twice—just slip it on and go
  • Soft, breathable fabric that moves with your body, never clings or pulls
  • Flattering relaxed silhouette that skims your frame beautifully
  • Practical pockets—finally, a dress that actually has them
  • Versatile enough to dress up or down depending on your day
  • Natural drape that looks effortlessly polished, whatever the occasion
  • The kind of everyday essential you'll wonder how you ever lived without
